_note: Pacing rules for the first days after a large time-zone shift. Applied when the absolute shift between the home time zone and the destination is at least min_shift_hours.
note: West-coast US to Japan is a 16-hour shift. The body clock lands at roughly 22:00 home time in the mid-afternoon. A 06:00 start on day two is 14:00 the previous day for the body, and children under ten do not reliably manage it. Day one after landing should hold at most two scheduled things.
